_doc: Hints for status names and raw result codes printed by the firmware ("<TAG> ERR <status> rslt=0x...": status = the board layer's status name, rslt = the driver/vendor library's raw code). Keys: status name, 0xXXXXXXXX, or a negative vendor code as decimal. Add a line whenever a debug session explains a new code; keep board-specific explanations in the board's README.
ERR_INIT: peripheral not initialised or its init failed - check the init order (bus before the sensors)
ERR_BUS: transfer error - the device answered its address but the transaction failed; see rslt
ERR_NODEV: no ACK / wrong chip id - wrong address, sensor unpowered, assembly/rework option, bus held
ERR_TIMEOUT: bounded wait expired - bus stuck (re-init / bus recovery) or clock stretching
ERR_NODATA: polled faster than the sensor's data rate - lower the rate or wait for data-ready
ERR_HW_SETTING: connector / jumper / switch / rework missing - see the board README
-1: Bosch SensorAPI E_NULL_PTR - a driver object or callback is NULL
-2: Bosch SensorAPI E_COM_FAIL - bus transfer failed after a good init: check the bus handle lifetime (a library may keep a pointer to a device struct - make it static), address, bus speed
-3: Bosch SensorAPI E_DEV_NOT_FOUND - chip id mismatch
-11: Bosch BMI2 self-test failed - keep the board still and flat during selftest
